desc: Design request queue between Claude and ChatGPT. Claude appends a row to the Greco Design Requests Google Sheet; an Apps Script time trigger (every 5 min) emails each new row with the [GRECO-DESIGN] subject tag; a ChatGPT Work event-triggered task (Gmail trigger) makes the design and delivers it to a Drive folder, or by a new GRECO-DONE email, or flags MANUAL SAVE NEEDED; the script collects the files and marks the row done. Code and task prompt in D:\Resume\work\tools\design-queue. Mock-tested 16/16 on 15 Oct 2026; not yet run live.
